scientific.integrity: The primary PDF was inspected at Example 6.2, its reproduction-number formula, Table 1, and Figures 1-2. The related 2017 full article was inspected at its model-family reproduction number and numerical delay discussion. The bundled exact checker independently reproduces all arithmetic. scientific.limitations: The result establishes an internal inconsistency among the published reproduction-number formula, parameter table, figure captions, and threshold interpretation. It does not reconstruct unavailable simulation code or identify which undocumented parameter values may have generated the plotted curves.

title: The numerical HIV threshold sweeps do not match the published reproduction number
